name: Exchange practical information bilingually
short_description: Complete a practical exchange in another language through either speech or writing.
self_assessment: I can exchange five practical details in another language without help through speech or writing.
description: Complete a practical exchange in another language through either speech or writing. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Arrange a meeting in another language
